name: gui_material_ray_query_from_blank
description: RTL-3s decisions 8 and 9 (engine FO-2), from Blank with the GUI only. File > New Project > Blank; Add Object > Cube and a Forward opaque material pass read by present (gui_material_from_blank's way). A surface that queries the scene's acceleration structure is written into the project's shaders (a person's own editor); New material on OpenPBR, bound to every Cube, New material on that surface: the pass does not declare ray_query, so the engine asks for a restart. Started again, the engine lists material.pass_contract_unmet@1 for the root's graph node render_material_pass and list_materials says unusable. The Materials dock's row says the pass and what to do there and offers Open the pass, which picks the pass on the Graph; the Problems row goes to the same pass (not to the Materials dock). Ray query On in the pass's fields: without a restart the engine takes the material in and the problems go; bound to every Cube, the box takes the surface's green. Typed: the project folder and its name in New Project; the surface's text is written by the scenario as a person's own editor would.
